title: Practice App Install
description: When you open a new app, it might ask for permission to see your personal information. You are in charge—you get to say yes or no! Let's practice with a new Flashlight app. You cannot break anything here!

challenges.requestText: Super Bright Flashlight would like to access your Contacts.
challenges.context: A flashlight has no reason to know the phone numbers of your friends and family.
challenges.justInTimeHint: Does a flashlight really need your contacts to work?

challenges.requestText: Super Bright Flashlight would like to access your Microphone.
challenges.context: A flashlight does not need to listen to your conversations.
challenges.justInTimeHint: Does a flashlight really need your microphone to work?

challenges.requestText: Super Bright Flashlight would like to access your Camera.
challenges.context: The bright light on a phone is physically built into the camera. The app needs camera permission just to turn the light bulb on!
challenges.justInTimeHint: Think about how a phone makes a bright light. It uses the bulb next to the camera lens!

gentleFailureUnnecessaryAllow.title: A Perfect Place to Practice!
gentleFailureUnnecessaryAllow.message: It is so easy to just click 'Allow' to make screens go away! But you are the boss of your device. A flashlight only makes light, so it doesn't need your contacts or microphone. You can always say 'Deny' and protect your privacy. Let's keep practicing this great habit!

gentleFailureNecessaryDeny.title: Excellent Privacy Instincts!
gentleFailureNecessaryDeny.message: You have a wonderful instinct to say 'Deny' and protect your privacy! This particular one is a fascinating technical detail: the phone's light bulb is physically part of the camera. So it does need camera permission just to turn the light on! You are doing a fantastic job thinking critically.

success.title: Masterful Work!
success.message: You thought carefully about exactly what the app needed. You protected your personal information but allowed the one connection it physically needed to work. You are truly the boss of your device!
